fleet.bar.vehiclesOut: {active} of {total, plural, one {# vehicle} other {# vehicles}} out
fleet.update.aria: A new version is ready — update now
fleet.update.title: Update the app
fleet.offline: No signal — showing what we last knew.
fleet.orders.title: Orders
fleet.orders.lede: Orders from the shippers you have a contract with, by the day they must arrive. They are yours alone: they are on no board, and only your office puts them on a truck.
fleet.orders.dayEmpty: No orders for this day yet.
fleet.orders.noneFits: No truck out now has {weight} free
fleet.orders.sumAllPlanned: every one planned or on a truck
fleet.orders.behind: Behind — {n} from earlier days not delivered
fleet.orders.track: Tracking page — what the shipper and the receiver see
fleet.orders.putOn: Put it on a truck that is out now
fleet.orders.nobodyOut: Nobody is on a shift. An order goes on a truck that is out — start a shift first.
fleet.orders.assignHint: The same checks as any load: room, equipment, the driver’s hours. The driver is told at once.
fleet.orders.aloud: {day}: {n, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}}, {unplanned} without a truck.
fleet.orders.noPin: Address not on the map — open it and pin it, or it cannot be planned
fleet.orders.pin.map: Map: where this order is delivered
fleet.orders.pin.how: The map does not know this address. Type a nearby place and find it, then tap the map where the goods go.
fleet.orders.pin.set: That is where the plan will send the truck. Move the pin if it is not right.
fleet.orders.withdrawHint: Your office uploaded it, so your office can take it back. Its number can then be sent again.
fleet.upload.title: Orders for {shipper}
fleet.upload.lede: A sheet of their orders: the Excel workbook itself, a CSV file, or cells copied from a spreadsheet and pasted. It is checked first — nothing is added until you say so.
fleet.upload.pickupMap: Map: where the goods are collected
fleet.upload.pinned: Pinned. Every line without its own collection point is collected here.
fleet.upload.geoFound: Found {where}. Move the pin if it is not the gate.
fleet.upload.geoGuess: That name is not on our map — this is a best guess. Tap the map to place it yourself.
fleet.upload.geoNotFound: Could not find that place — tap the map to place it.
fleet.upload.noPin: Type the name and find it, or tap the map. Lines with their own collection point do not need this.
fleet.upload.file: The sheet: an Excel workbook (.xlsx) or a CSV file
fleet.upload.pastePh: Order number, Goods, Weight, Deliver to, Delivery date …
fleet.upload.fromWorkbook: From the workbook {name}: its first sheet is read.
fleet.upload.tooBig: That workbook is larger than 1 MB — a sheet of orders is far smaller. Save only the sheet with the orders, or save it as CSV.
fleet.upload.columns: The first line names the columns: an order number, the goods, the weight, where to deliver and the date (2026-10-06 or 06/10/2026). A latitude and longitude put the address on the map.
fleet.upload.template: Download a template to send them
fleet.upload.notText: That kind of spreadsheet file is not read here. Save it as an Excel workbook (.xlsx) or as CSV, or copy the cells and paste them below.
fleet.upload.notSheet: That is not a sheet of orders. Use an Excel workbook, a CSV file, or paste the cells below.
fleet.upload.ready: {n, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} ready
fleet.upload.duplicates: {n} already here, left as they are
fleet.upload.duplicatesOne: 1 already here, left as it is
fleet.upload.unlocatedOne: 1 has an address our map does not know. It is added without a point and cannot be planned until you pin it — or add a latitude and longitude to the sheet.
fleet.upload.unlocated: {n} have an address our map does not know. They are added without a point and cannot be planned until you pin them — or add a latitude and longitude to the sheet.
fleet.upload.import: Add {n, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}}
fleet.upload.partial: The lines with a problem are left out. Put them right and upload the sheet again — the ones already added are not added twice.
fleet.upload.done: {n, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} added.
fleet.orders.planAccepted: Plan accepted by {who} at {when}: {planned, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} on {trucks, plural, one {# vehicle} other {# vehicles}}.
fleet.orders.planAcceptedOne: Plan accepted by {who} at {when}: {planned, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} on 1 vehicle.
fleet.orders.planLeft: {n} did not fit — open the plan to see why.
fleet.orders.planLeftOne: 1 did not fit — open the plan to see why.
fleet.orders.planNew: {n, plural, one {# order has} other {# orders have}} come in since — plan again.
fleet.orders.planNewOne: 1 order has come in since — plan again.
fleet.orders.plannedLate: Planned about {by} after the window asked for.
fleet.orders.plannedEarly: Planned about {by} before its window opens.
fleet.plan.title: Plan for {day}
fleet.plan.nothing: No order for this day is waiting for a truck.
fleet.plan.head: {planned} of {orders, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} on {used} of your {trucks, plural, one {# vehicle} other {# vehicles}}
fleet.plan.hire: You are short: about {n} more trucks of {size}
fleet.plan.hireOne: You are short: about 1 more truck of {size}
fleet.plan.hireDetail: {orders, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} ({weight}) do not fit your own trucks and drivers for this day. That is what they would take in trucks like your largest.
fleet.plan.allFit: Everything for the day fits your own trucks.
fleet.roster.title: Who drives: {day}
fleet.roster.shiftAria: The shift {name} starts on that day
fleet.roster.notSet: Nobody has said who drives that day, so a plan counts every active driver. Tick the ones who drive and save.
fleet.roster.noDrivers: This fleet has no active driver to put on a day.
fleet.roster.hint: A driver you put on the day is told; one you take off it is told too. Anybody can still start a shift: the plan follows the vehicle, and whoever drives it takes its trips.
fleet.roster.save: Save: {n, plural, =0 {nobody drives} one {# driver drives} other {# drivers drive}}
fleet.roster.saved: Saved. The plan above was worked out again with it.
fleet.roster.savedAccepted: Saved. The accepted plan stays as it was: plan the day again to use it.
fleet.roster.planEveryone: Nobody has said who drives that day: the plan counts all {n, plural, one {# active driver} other {# active drivers}}. Say who drives below.
fleet.roster.planNobody: Nobody is on the roster for that day: no vehicle goes out, and every order is work to hire.
fleet.roster.planCounted: Planned for the {n, plural, one {# driver} other {# drivers}} on the roster: {names}.
fleet.plan.driversShort: You have {drivers, plural, one {# driver} other {# drivers}} for {trucks, plural, one {# vehicle} other {# vehicles}}: the plan sends out no more vehicles than drivers.
fleet.plan.estimate: Times are estimates: trucks leave at {start}, a day is at most {hours}, {speed} km/h on the road, {load} min to load an order and {unload} min to hand one over.
fleet.plan.dist.roads: Distances are by road, from the routing server.
fleet.plan.dist.gaps: {n, plural, one {# leg has} other {# legs have}} no road on its map and are estimated.
fleet.plan.dist.gapOne: 1 leg has no road on its map and is estimated.
fleet.plan.dist.estimate: Distances are estimates too: straight lines with an allowance for the road.
fleet.plan.dist.fallback: Distances are estimates, not by road: {why}. Plan again in a moment for road distances.
fleet.orders.done.inside: Handed over at {at}, inside its window ({window})
fleet.orders.done.after: Handed over at {at} — {by} after its window ({window})
fleet.orders.done.before: Handed over at {at} — {by} before its window ({window})
fleet.orders.done.dayLate: Handed over at {at} on {day} — it was ordered for {ordered}
fleet.orders.done.dayEarly: Handed over at {at} on {day}, before the day it was ordered for ({ordered})
fleet.plan.clock.country: Times are on your office’s clock: {name} ({zone}), where it is {now} now.
fleet.plan.clock.office: Times are on the clock your office chose: {name} ({zone}), where it is {now} now.
fleet.plan.clock.none: Your office’s clock is not known: your country keeps more than one time zone. Until you choose, “today” is the day in UTC, and nobody can be told whether a delivery was on time or is running late.
fleet.plan.tellsShippers: Accepting tells the shipper of each order that is left out, or outside its window — where the shipper placed the order itself. Orders your office typed in or uploaded have nobody to tell.
fleet.plan.acceptedNote: Accepted. Each order now shows its truck and trip. On the day, a truck gets its first trip when its driver starts a shift in it, and the next when that one is delivered.
fleet.plan.send.cta: Send the next trips out now
fleet.plan.send.hint: Trips go out by themselves as shifts start and loads are delivered. Use this for a plan accepted after the trucks left, or a truck that was waiting.
fleet.plan.send.sent: {plate}: trip {trip} is with {driver} — {n, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}}.
fleet.plan.send.noneWent: {plate}: nothing of trip {trip} could go on.
fleet.plan.send.noDriver: {plate}: nobody is on a shift in it yet.
fleet.plan.send.carrying: {plate}: {driver} still has goods aboard — the next trip follows when they are delivered.
fleet.plan.send.offRoad: {why}. Its trips wait: plan the day again to put them on another truck.
fleet.plan.send.done: {plate}: every trip planned on it has gone out.
fleet.plan.proposal: A proposal — nothing changes until you accept it.
fleet.plan.asAccepted: This is the plan as it was accepted.
fleet.plan.proposalReplaces: A new proposal. Accepting it replaces the plan accepted before; until then that one stands.
fleet.plan.f.trucksHint: Tap one to leave it out of this plan. The plan is worked out again each time.
fleet.plan.shiftLine: {site}, {shift} from {start}: {rostered, plural, =0 {nobody rostered} one {# driver rostered} other {# drivers rostered}} · {needed, plural, =0 {none needed} one {# needed} other {# needed}}
fleet.plan.dayLine: {site}, from {start}: {rostered, plural, =0 {nobody rostered} one {# driver rostered} other {# drivers rostered}} · {needed, plural, =0 {none needed} one {# needed} other {# needed}}
fleet.plan.siteLine: {site}: {used} of {trucks, plural, one {# truck} other {# trucks}} out · {drivers, plural, =0 {nobody starts here} one {# driver starts here} other {# drivers start here}}
fleet.sites.title: Your sites
fleet.sites.lead: The depots and yards your trucks and drivers work from. The day’s plan starts each truck from its own site, and sends no more trucks out of a site than drivers start there.
fleet.sites.mapAria: {n, plural, one {Your site on a map} other {Your # sites on a map}}
fleet.sites.dropHint: Tap the map where the site is, or type its point.
fleet.sites.name: Name
fleet.sites.counts: {vehicles, plural, =0 {No vehicles} one {# vehicle} other {# vehicles}} · {drivers, plural, =0 {no drivers} one {# driver} other {# drivers}} work from here
fleet.sites.homesLead: Each vehicle and driver works from one site. The roster can say a driver starts somewhere else for a day.
fleet.sites.noShifts: No shifts: trucks leave at the time the day’s plan is asked for. Add shifts where drivers start at set times — an early and a late one let a truck go out twice, with two drivers.
fleet.sites.baysHint: How many trucks can load there at once. When every bay is taken, the plan has the next truck wait for one.
fleet.sites.alwaysOpen: Open for loading at any hour. Tick to set its hours: a truck that comes before it opens waits at the gate, and nothing is collected there on a closed day.
fleet.use.title: How the vehicles were used
fleet.use.lead: From what was recorded: the shifts started in each vehicle, the odometer readings given, the loads delivered and the runs driven, and the days it was off the road. Never how anybody drove.
fleet.use.fleet: {n, plural, one {The whole fleet: # vehicle} other {The whole fleet: # vehicles}}
fleet.use.out: Out {out} of {of, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} · {hours} h on shift, {shifts, plural, one {# shift} other {# shifts}}
fleet.use.outMany: Out {out} of {of, plural, one {# vehicle-day} other {# vehicle-days}} · {hours} h on shift, {shifts, plural, one {# shift} other {# shifts}}
fleet.use.loads: {n, plural, one {# load} other {# loads}} delivered, {kg} kg
fleet.use.loaded: {pct}% of the km to and with loads ran loaded
fleet.use.runs: {n, plural, one {# run} other {# runs}}, {kg} kg booked
fleet.use.offRoad: {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} off the road
fleet.use.idle: {n, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} idle
fleet.plan.trip.bay: Waits {by} at {site} for a loading bay
fleet.plan.trip.afterClose: Still loading {by} after {site} closes — planned all the same
fleet.plan.overShift: Back {by} after its shift ends: it waited for a loading bay
fleet.plan.overShiftNote: {n, plural, one {# truck is} other {# trucks are}} back after the shift ends, from waiting for a loading bay
fleet.plan.overShiftDetail: The plan puts orders on trucks first and hands out the bays after, in the order trucks come for them. A later shift, another site or more bays on Sites gives them the time back.
fleet.plan.lend: {site} is short of trucks: {plates}, standing at {from}, would carry {orders, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} left here ({weight}). Move {n, plural, one {it} other {them}} here on Sites, and roster {n, plural, one {a driver} other {drivers}} to start here.
fleet.plan.load.baysShared: {n, plural, one {# bay} other {# bays}}, counting your trucks only
fleet.plan.load.waits: {n, plural, one {# waited for a bay} other {# waited for a bay}}, the longest {by}
fleet.plan.load.afterClose: {n, plural, one {# still loading after it closes} other {# still loading after it closes}}
fleet.plan.tripSub: from {from} · {weight} · {empty} km empty to get there
fleet.plan.win.late: About {by} after its window ({window}). It is planned all the same.
fleet.plan.win.early: About {by} before its window opens ({window}): the day has no room to wait.
fleet.plan.win.waits: The vehicle waits {by} for the window to open ({window}).
fleet.plan.win.unread: "{words}" is not a time the plan could read, so it is planned to the day only. Write it as 8-12, or before 14:00.
fleet.plan.win.outside: {n, plural, one {# order is} other {# orders are}} planned outside the window asked for
fleet.plan.win.outsideOne: 1 order is planned outside the window asked for
fleet.plan.win.outsideDetail: Each is marked in its vehicle’s day below, with by how much. Nothing is left out because of a window: a later start, a longer day, another vehicle or a partner can bring it back inside.
fleet.plan.win.unreadMany: {n} delivery windows are in words the plan could not read as a time. Those orders are planned to the day only; each is marked below.
fleet.plan.win.unreadOne: 1 delivery window is in words the plan could not read as a time. That order is planned to the day only; it is marked below.
fleet.plan.left.noPinDo: These addresses have no point, so no truck can be routed to them. Open each order and pin it, then plan again.
fleet.plan.left.noDriver: A truck is free, but no driver — {n}
fleet.plan.left.noDriverDo: You have trucks standing for these, and nobody left to drive them. A hired driver covers them.
fleet.plan.left.noTime: No room left in the day — {n}
fleet.plan.left.noTimeDo: Every truck that could take these is full for the day. More trucks cover them, or a longer day.
fleet.plan.left.noTrucksDo: No truck of yours is going out on this day.
fleet.plan.left.siteClosed: Collected at a site that is closed that day — {n}
fleet.plan.left.siteClosedDo: These are collected at one of your own sites, and its hours say it is closed on this day. Change its hours on Sites, or move the orders to another day.
fleet.plan.left.dockClosed: Collected where the shipper says it is closed that day — {n}
fleet.plan.left.dockClosedDo: The shipper keeps loading hours for the place these are collected from, and they say it is closed on this day. Their shipper is told so. Ask them, or move the orders to another day.
fleet.plan.left.cannotCarry: No truck of yours can handle these — {n}
fleet.plan.left.cannotCarryDo: They need equipment or a body none of your trucks that is big enough has (a tail lift, a crane, a tipper). Hire one that has it.
fleet.plan.left.tooHeavyDo: No truck of yours carries this much at once. It needs a bigger truck — or split it into loads here, and each load is planned on its own. Goods that are one piece cannot be split.
fleet.split.title: Split {code} into loads
fleet.split.stillHeavy: Each load is still more than your largest vehicle carries ({size}). Add a load.
fleet.split.told: Each load is planned, carried and signed for on its own, and the shipper is told its order comes in parts. You can put it back together while no load is on a truck or handed on.
fleet.split.confirm: Split it into {n, plural, one {# load} other {# loads}}
fleet.split.loadOf: Load {no} of {of} of order {order} — {weight} in all
fleet.split.rejoinHint: One order again, at its whole weight. Only while every load of it is still without a truck and in your own hands. The shipper is told.
fleet.handOn.offered: {n, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}} offered to {to}.
fleet.handOn.released: {n, plural, one {# order is} other {# orders are}} on the open board.
fleet.handOn.releasedOne: 1 order is on the open board.
fleet.handOn.title: If you cannot carry it
fleet.handOn.offerHint: All your partner fleets are asked at once. The first to take it carries it; you stay the carrier the shipper ordered from.
fleet.handOn.noPartners: You have named no partner fleet yet. Do that under Partners, below the contracts.
fleet.handOn.releaseCta: Put it on the open board
fleet.handOn.releaseHint: Any checked carrier can take it at the board’s price. You pay them yourself.
fleet.handOn.withPartner: {partner} took it on {when} and carries it.
fleet.handOn.onBoard: On the open board since {when}. No carrier has taken it yet.
fleet.handOn.takeBackCta: Take it back off the board
fleet.handOn.fromPartner: From {fleet}. You took it on {when}; it is yours to plan and carry.
fleet.handOn.fromPartnerShort: From {fleet}. It is yours to plan and carry.
fleet.handOn.passOnCta: Pass it on to your partners
fleet.handOn.passOnHint: {fleet} allows you to. All your own partner fleets are asked at once; the first to take it carries it, and {fleet} sees who that is. It can be passed on once, no further.
fleet.handOn.passOnNotAllowed: {fleet} has not said its orders may be passed on. Carry it, or give it back.
fleet.handOn.noFurther: It was passed on to you: it can be carried or given back, not passed on again.
fleet.handOn.passedOn: {partner} took it from you on {when} and carries it. You passed it on; if they give it back it is yours again.
fleet.handOn.withThird: {via} passed it on to {partner}, who took it on {when} and carries it.
fleet.handOn.partnerOffering: {partner} is offering it on to its own partners: {to}.
fleet.handOn.handBackWhy: Why you are giving it back
fleet.handOn.handBackHint: They are told, with your reason. Once it is on one of your trucks it is carried.
fleet.handOn.offerToYou: {fleet} is offering you this order. The first fleet to take it carries it.
fleet.orders.offeredLede: Orders a partner fleet cannot carry itself. Take one and it is yours to plan and carry; leave it and it goes to their other partners.
fleet.partners.title: Partners
fleet.partners.lede: Other fleets you hand work to when you are short. You agree the price with them yourself.
fleet.partners.linked: Linked on {when} — you can offer them orders
fleet.partners.mayPassOn: They may pass my orders on to a partner of their own
fleet.partners.theyAllow: You may pass their orders on to a partner of your own.
fleet.partners.theyDoNotAllow: Their orders are yours to carry, not to pass on.
fleet.partners.codeOut: Waiting for them to enter your code, good until {until}
fleet.partners.nameLabel: A fleet you hand work to
fleet.partners.nameCta: Name them and get a code
fleet.partners.codeHint: Send this to their fleet office. They enter it under Orders, Partners. It works once, until {until}, and is not shown again.
fleet.partners.linkLabel: A code another fleet sent you
fleet.partners.offeredBy: Fleets that can offer you orders
fleet.plan.handOn.title: The {n} that do not fit
fleet.plan.handOn.releaseCta: Put them on the open board
fleet.plan.handOn.hint: Partners first: the first to take an order carries it. The open board is for what no partner takes.
fleet.contracts.title: Contracts
fleet.contracts.lede: The shippers you carry for under a contract. Their orders come straight to you. The price and the terms stay on your own paper with them.
fleet.contracts.linked: Their business linked it on {when} — they order here directly
fleet.contracts.notLinked: Not linked to their business yet
fleet.contracts.offered: Offered to {name} in its app — waiting for an owner there to accept
fleet.contracts.declined: Declined in its app on {when} — not linked
fleet.contracts.fromAsk: {name} asked you for a contract through the logistics directory. Recorded here, it is offered to it in its app: an owner there accepts it, and no code is needed.
fleet.contracts.f.termsHint: No price here: what you charge them is on your contract, between you.
fleet.contracts.codeHint: Send this to the shipper. An owner of their business enters it under Carriers in the Business app. It works once, until {until}. It is not shown again — send a new one if it is lost.
fleet.runs.title: Runs
fleet.runs.lede: Put a departure on one of your lines and shippers can book the space you are not using. You say what it costs; you say how long loading may take before the clock starts.
fleet.runs.none: No runs yet. Declare one below and it goes on the board for shippers to find.
fleet.runs.noLines: You need a published line first. Propose one on the Lines tab — the network publishes it, and then you can sell space on it.
fleet.runs.linePh: Choose one of your published lines
